en.title: AML 14.1.1(i): training on findings "described in Chapter 13"; the findings are in Chapter 12
en.summary: AML 14.1.1(i) requires employees to understand the relevant findings, recommendations and directives "described in Chapter 13". They are defined in Chapter 12 (12.2.1), and the parallel MLRO duty in 13.6.1(g) correctly refers to Chapter 12.
en.correction: Replace "Chapter 13" with "Chapter 12" in AML 14.1.1(i) (an editorial correction of a reference under section 19(3)(a) of the AIFC Regulations on AIFC Acts).
